'''Outpost Warden''' was a military outpost situated in the [[Dark Temple pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. It was the base camp for several research projects in the area, and was also tasked with guarding the end of the pass and the road to [[Kaas City]], as the pass was filled with crazed [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who had been driven mad by the [[Dark Temple]].
